Wiglett

Water

Paldea · Generation 9

Wiglett is a Water-type Garden Eel Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 1.8 kg. It evolves into Wugtrio. Its highest base stat is Speed (95), with a base stat total of 245.
